def desc(p): return dict(path=str(p),sha256=sha(p))
checks=[]
def check(v,label):
    assert v,label
    checks.append(label)
old=B/'independent-installed-defaults-review.json'
check(sha(old)=='336c7ce3d093f041f72fe0b6f5885fbac338f0763da0ebb46141bbd608b6c413','previous installed receipt immutable')

w=json.loads(wp.read_text())

for p in docpaths:
    check((H/'internal_interpretation_core.md').is_file() and '(internal_interpretation_core.md)' in p.read_text(),'new core link '+p.name)
note=H/'internal_interpretation_core.md'
check(sha(note)=='a6e183dfe07410dc21f0e9abed2f96b34f1375a2b83ad5d4e9b5871df656deb5','installed note exact reviewed successor')
nt=note.read_text()
check('For shift-fixed theorem codes' in nt and 'all 42 inputs' in nt,'shift premise and original actual 42-input count retained')
for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',nt):
    if '://' not in link: check((note.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve().exists(),'note link '+link)
compat=Path('/tmp/zfc-native-interp-ac89-source-review/import-compatibility-supplement.json')
check(sha(compat)=='720092f8e024a7a6c7ce9444593beec169aba61663cd51d53d8c21d7108367fa','prior compatibility receipt immutable')
ni=R/'Logic/Interpretability/ZFCinPA/Lean/ZFCinPA/NativeInterp.lean'
original=Path('/tmp/zfc-native-interp-ac89-source-review/NativeInterp.lean')
check(ni.read_text()==original.read_text().replace('import ZFCinPA.InternalInterpretation\n','import ZFCinPA.InternalInterpretation\nimport ZFCinPA.ConstructibleInterpretation\n'),'exact one-import compatibility successor remains')
